name: Berggasthof Moosbauer
beschreibung: Berggasthof Moosbauer is located in the municipality of Erl in the Tyrolean Lower Inn Valley. The establishment operates as a traditional inn, providing comfortable accommodations alongside dining hospitality. The kitchen prepares predominantly regional and seasonal dishes. Guest rooms are practically furnished and equipped with modern en-suite sanitary facilities. Various scenic hiking trails in the Kaisergebirge are easily accessible from the inn. The cultural town of Erl, renowned for its Passion Plays, lies in close proximity.
